verdict.rationale: Conductor's changelog announces 'routines' that run agents on a schedule or via GitHub Action. Cloud sandboxes keep agents working after the laptop closes, and cloud agents can run builds without per-step confirmation, so the core scheduled/triggered capability is first-party. However, routines appear only in a single changelog line, with no dedicated docs on configuration, trigger types, or autonomous maintain-and-fix workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated routines documentation (setup, trigger options, recurrence controls), evidence of end-to-end autonomous fix/PR flows from routines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
agents keep working after you close your laptop.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
